schedulerRootCause: GitHub Radar pipeline (ingest-hn, rank-daily, etc.) lives on 'github_radar' branch only. No systemd unit or crontab exists for it. The installed systemd units only cover fetch and summarize on main branch.
recommendedFix: 1. Merge or deploy github_radar branch. 2. Create github-digest-radar.service + github-digest-radar.timer (OnCalendar=*-*-* 09:00:00, one hour after fetch). 3. systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl enable --now github-digest-radar.timer
suggestedCrontab:

0 8 * * * cd /opt/github-digest && flock -n /tmp/gd-fetch.lock .venv/bin/github-digest fetch >> /var/log/github-digest/fetch.log 2>&1
# Radar pipeline (09:00 UTC, after fetch)
0 9 * * * cd /opt/github-digest && flock -n /tmp/gd-radar.lock .venv/bin/python3 run_daily_pipeline.py --skip-github >> /var/log/github-digest/radar.log 2>&1
